observations: Three photos show a white and grey wall-mounted hair dryer with a coiled cord.
The brand 'MMAAT' is visible in blue text on the front of the dryer in all photos.
The text 'BATHROOMS' is printed below 'MMAAT' in all photos.
The dryer is mounted on a textured white wall with visible stains and discoloration.
The cord is white and coiled, with a black plug visible in photo 1.
No power cord is visible in photo 0 or photo 2; only the wall-mounted part is shown.
No model number or serial number is visible on the dryer in any photo.
The dryer appears to be in used condition with some surface wear and discoloration on the wall.

claims.evidence: The brand 'MMAAT' is visible in all photos, but 'quality' is subjective and not verifiable from photos alone.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year. No fault at all, the motor was never opened. Receipt and warranty card available.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The dryer may not be functional or may have internal damage not visible in photos.
risks.proof: A video showing the dryer turning on and blowing air, or a photo of the power cord and plug with the plug inserted into a socket.

risks.risk: The wall mounting bracket may be loose or damaged, affecting stability.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the mounting bracket and its attachment to the wall.

risks.risk: The cord may be frayed or damaged, posing a safety hazard.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the entire cord, especially near the plug and where it connects to the dryer.

proof_requests: Video of the dryer turning on and blowing air.
Close-up photo of the power cord and plug.
Close-up photo of the mounting bracket and its attachment to the wall.
Close-up photo of the entire cord, especially near the plug.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
